From: Priya Raman <priya.raman@halefoundation.example>
To: Morgan Reyes <morgan.reyes@cedarcommons.example>
Date: Monday 9 November 2026, 08:14
Subject: Friday site visit

Hi Morgan,

I'm sorry to do this on short notice, but our team retreat now overlaps with
Friday's site visit. Could we move it to Tuesday the 17th or Wednesday the
18th, at 10 either day? Same plan otherwise: an hour with you and Dana, then a
walk through the Elm Street site.

Also, a quick check while I have you: is the interim report still on track for
November 30? We'd love to have it a few days early if you can manage it, since
our renewal review starts on December 1.

Thanks,
Priya

Priya Raman
Program Officer, Hale Foundation

To: Priya Raman <priya.raman@halefoundation.example>
Subject: Re: Friday site visit

Hi Priya,

Tuesday the 17th at 10 works for me and Dana. Same plan: an hour with us, then the walk through the Elm Street site.

On the interim report, we can't send it early. Our finance close isn't done until the 25th, and the report needs those final figures. It will be in your hands by November 30, ahead of your December 1 review start.

If it would help your review to see anything sooner, tell me and I'll see what we can share without the final numbers.

Thanks,
Morgan
EOF
